brief: Caps the retries of a whole workload with an engine token bucket, so a storm of failures cannot turn into a retry storm.
detail: A budget of N retries refills over a window of W seconds, at floor(N / W) retries a second and never less than one. Ask Allow before every retry; when it answers FALSE, fail instead of retrying. One budget guards one workload; for many independent keys use stzRateLimiter.
